metrics.definition: Fractions; AIA is mean stage sample-weighted all-seen accuracy; forgetting averages old tasks only.

cnn.definition: Fractions; AIA is mean stage sample-weighted all-seen accuracy; forgetting averages old tasks only.

assumptions: Missing within-class feature/residual cross covariance is modelled as zero, not proved by cross-fitting.
A pooled residual covariance approximates class-conditional uncertainty.
Replay can be model-dependent and is not asserted to be gradient-independent.

shared_basis.bias: flat prior, recovered from centered moments
shared_basis.weighting: unit weight per historical fitting row; no class reweighting
shared_basis.history: caller-supplied surrogate full snapshot; true nonlinear history unknown
shared_basis.objective_interpretation: centered Gaussian moment surrogate; not true-history marginal likelihood
shared_basis.prior_initialization: reset to isotropic epsilon I in current feature coordinates

statistics.history_snapshot_operation: replace; never accumulate a transported snapshot twice
statistics.classification_readout: shared empirical-Bayes predictor with flat intercept
statistics.transport_ridge_role: auxiliary transport readout only; deployed isotropic penalty is noise_variance/epsilon

statistics.replay_gradient_independence: not assumed; resident replay may have trained the encoder
